play.title: Pulse - Business Card Reader
play.shortDescription: Scan business & visiting cards to contacts. Many cards in one photo. Expo-ready.
play.fullDescription:
Pulse is a business card reader and visiting card scanner built for India's expos, trade fairs and meetings. Point your camera at a card and it becomes a contact you can call, WhatsApp or save to your phone, in seconds, with nothing to type.

EXHIBITION MODE FOR EVERY EXPO
Create an event and every card you scan is filed under it. See how many cards you collected today, spot duplicates, and export each event to Excel (CSV) or vCard when the show ends. In exhibition mode your stall gets a QR code too: visitors scan it and leave their details straight in your app.

MANY CARDS, ONE PHOTO
Lay a stack of business cards flat and take one picture. The card scanner finds every card and reads everyone on them. A card that lists partners or directors becomes one contact per person, and the front and back of a card are read together.

YOUR DIGITAL BUSINESS CARD
Make your own digital card in a minute. Share it on WhatsApp as a picture or a contact file, or let people scan its QR code.

EVERY DETAIL, READ RIGHT
Pulse is a card reader made for Indian visiting cards: +91 mobile numbers, STD codes for landlines, GSTIN, and cards in Hindi, Gujarati, Tamil and other regional scripts. Anything that needs a second look is flagged, so you can correct it in a tap.

NEVER GO INTO A CALL COLD
Pulse Brief reads up on the person and their company, and gives you conversation starters before you call or WhatsApp.

FOLLOW UP IN ONE TAP
Call or WhatsApp straight from the contact. Add notes by voice, set follow-up dates, star the people who matter, and save contacts as "Name (Company)" so the company shows when they call you.

YOUR CONTACTS STAY YOURS
Contacts live on your phone. Export them any time to Excel (CSV) or vCard, at no cost. Sync across your phones only if you turn it on. No ads and no tracking.

PLANS
Reading cards needs a Google sign-in. Every account gets 20 cards a month free. Paid plans, card packs and an Exhibition pass are there for busy weeks and big shows.
